text: {"summary": "The k3d-workload-auditor cluster has weak workload hardening and broad RBAC. Kubescape scores are NSA 61.1, MITRE 62.5 and cis-v1.12.0 48.7. Trivy reports 12 CRITICAL image vulnerabilities, including traefik, metrics-server, grafana and loki-gateway. Four cluster-admin bindings exist, and most look like k3s or platform defaults except argocd-manager. These are k3s-managed add-ons.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Critical CVE brotli-libs in grafana and loki-gateway images", "resource": "monitoring/Deployment/kps-grafana; monitoring/Deployment/loki-gateway", "controls": ["CVE-2026-111497"], "evidence": "CVE-2026-111497 brotli-libs installed 1.2.0-r1, fixed 1.2.1-r0.", "fix": "Bump the grafana and loki-gateway image tags to builds with brotli-libs 1.2.1-r0 (or rebuild the base with 'apk upgrade brotli-libs').", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "argocd-manager has cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager (ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager)", "controls": ["C-0185", "C-0187", "KSV-0111", "KSV-0044", "KSV-0046"], "evidence": "Binding argocd-manager grants role cluster-admin to ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager (KSV-0111 'User with admin access').", "fix": "Replace it with a scoped ClusterRole listing only the resource groups Argo CD deploys. Command: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding argocd-manager, then bind the scoped role.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Go library and stdlib CVEs in argo-rollouts, dashboard and cert-manager", "resource": "argo-rollouts/Deployment/argo-rollouts; argo-rollouts/Deployment/argo-rollouts-dashboard; cert-manager/Deployment/cert-manager", "controls": ["CVE-2026-84304", "CVE-2026-84445", "GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf", "CVE-2026-78669", "CVE-2026-56854", "CVE-2026-116587", "CVE-2026-111943"], "evidence": "CVE-2026-84304 in google.golang.org/grpc installed v1.80.0, fixed 1.83.1; cert-manager has CVE-2026-116587 go-jose v4.1.4, fixed 4.1.6.", "fix": "Upgrade to the latest argo-rollouts and cert-manager releases built with Go >= 1.26.10 or 1.27.3, grpc >= 1.83.2, x/net >= 0.60.0 and go-jose >= 4.1.6.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Wide RBAC: secret access, wildcard roles and cluster-admin on platform accounts", "resource": "ClusterRoles admin, cluster-admin, cert-manager-cainjector, k3s-cloud-controller-manager, local-path-provisioner-role; ServiceAccounts helm-traefik, helm-traefik-crd", "controls": ["C-0015", "C-0186", "C-0007", "C-0188", "KSV-0041", "KSV-0046", "KSV-0045", "KSV-0114", "KSV-0111"], "evidence": "C-0015 'List Kubernetes secrets' fails on 26 resources, KSV-0041 'Manage secrets' on 21, and KSV-0045 'No wildcard verb roles' on 2.", "fix": "Scope the roles to named resources and verbs. Remove delete/create-pod rights where not needed. The bindings Group:/system:masters, helm-kube-system-traefik and helm-kube-system-traefik-crd look like k3s defaults (medium risk).", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Missing security context, non-root and resource limits across workloads", "resource": "demo-dev/demo-prod workloads and system namespaces (32 resources)", "controls": ["C-0211", "C-0013", "C-0270", "C-0271", "KSV-0118", "KSV-0014", "DS-0002", "KSV-0012"], "evidence": "C-0211 fails on 32 resources, C-0270 'Ensure CPU limits are set' on 30, C-0271 on 21, and C-0013 on 23.", "fix": "securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}. Also set resources.limits.cpu and memory.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Host access: node-exporter and svclb-traefik (expected platform pattern)", "resource": "monitoring/DaemonSet/kps-prometheus-node-exporter; kube-system/DaemonSet/svclb-traefik-f07ea201", "controls": ["C-0038", "C-0041", "C-0048", "C-0046", "KSV-0009", "KSV-0010", "KSV-0023", "KSV-0024", "KSV-0121", "KSV-0026"], "evidence": "KSV-0009 and KSV-0010 fail on monitoring/DaemonSet/kps-prometheus-node-exporter, and KSV-0024 'Access to host ports' on kube-system/DaemonSet/svclb-traefik-f07ea201.", "fix": "Accept as expected for node-exporter and the k3s svclb. Limit the hostPath mounts to read-only: volumeMounts: [{name: root, mountPath: /host/root, readOnly: true}].", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "No network policies and weak namespace boundaries", "resource": "Namespaces (12-28 resources)", "controls": ["C-0030", "C-0206", "C-0054", "C-0209", "C-0193", "C-0202"], "evidence": "C-0030 'Ingress and Egress blocked' fails on 28 resources and C-0206 on 12 namespaces.", "fix": "Add a default-deny NetworkPolicy per namespace: spec: {podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]}, then allow required flows.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Service account tokens auto-mounted and default SAs in use", "resource": "25 workloads, 80 service accounts", "controls": ["C-0034", "C-0190", "C-0053", "C-0189"], "evidence": "C-0034 'Automatic mapping of service account' fails on 25 resources and C-0053 on 80.", "fix": "Set automountServiceAccountToken: false on pods and ServiceAccounts that do not call the API.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Secrets-like content in ConfigMaps and jobs", "resource": "argo-rollouts/ConfigMap/argo-rollouts-notification-configmap; batch/v1/kube-system", "controls": ["KSV-0109", "KSV-01010", "C-0012"], "evidence": "KSV-0109 'ConfigMap with secrets' on argo-rollouts/ConfigMap/argo-rollouts-notification-configmap; C-0012 fails on 2 resources.", "fix": "Move the credentials to Secrets or External Secrets and reference them via secretKeyRef. The digest does not show whether the values are real, so verify.", "confidence": "low"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Repo misconfigs in k6-load.yaml and the demo-api Dockerfile", "resource": "apps/demo-api/base/k6-load.yaml; services/demo-api/Dockerfile", "controls": ["KSV-0014", "KSV-0125", "KSV-0011", "KSV-0110", "C-0270", "C-0017", "DS-0026"], "evidence": "KSV-0014 'Root file system is not read-only' (HIGH) on apps/demo-api/base/k6-load.yaml; DS-0026 'No HEALTHCHECK defined' on services/demo-api/Dockerfile.", "fix": "Add readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, CPU limits and a non-default namespace to k6-load; add HEALTHCHECK CMD to the Dockerfile.", "confidence": "high"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "kubescape argocd-lab-app", "reason": "Error: no scannable Kubernetes resources found for input \"/work/argocd-lab-app\""}, {"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Medium/low CVEs and the full CVE list", "reason": "the digest lists only critical/high CVEs for selected workloads (HIGH 1018, MEDIUM 1237 in total)"}]}
